text:
Sana (Partnerships): @here quick sync — EdgeCompute Co just confirmed capacity for the new eu-west5-eco region but with a caveat: they can guarantee 8x A100-equivalent GPUs at GA, not the 12 we requested. We need to decide: accept a smaller initial commit + burst plan, or push for 12 before marketplace entitlements and press. :thinking:

Mike (Cloud Ops): Can we short-term bridge with Dedicated burst capacity from eu-west3? If routing latency stays < 60ms for our P95 it's fine. I'll open a quota ticket anyway. :memo:

Jia (Product): Press timeline question — partner wants joint announcement the week of May 18. If we can't commit 12 GPUs by then, they may delay PR. We should scope messaging for GA vs. "early access". :speaker:

Omar (Eng Runtime): Runtime-wise we're green for eu-west5-eco — model pinning, quantization profiles, and KV-cache warmups tested on staging. The only risk is inter-region fallback complexity (eu-west3 -> eu-west5) for low-latency customers. We'd prefer clear SLA on burst routing. :white_check_mark:

Luis (Partner Eng): I pinged Anna at EdgeCompute: anna@edgecompute.co — she said they can commit an extra 4 GPUs for the first two weeks if we sign the marketplace entitlement and KMS addendum this week. They asked for the marketplace SKU name so their legal team can match it. :phone:

Sana (Partnerships): Ok, action items: 1) Mike open quota/entitlement ticket and add dedicated burst option; 2) Luis get written confirmation for the +4 GPUs; 3) Jia draft joint-announce copy that hedges GA vs early access; 4) Omar document fallback routing plan. Can we do all of this by EOD tomorrow? :hourglass:

Mike (Cloud Ops): Opening ticket now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REG-5991 — title: "eu-west5-eco marketplace quota + burst routing". Adding assignees: Mike, Eng-Networking, Partnerships. ETA: 48h for cloud quota approval, 24h for marketplace entitlement review. :link:

EdgeComputeBot: Contract status update: Partner contract (EdgeCompute Co) uploaded to /contracts/edgecompute/eu-west5 on 2026-03-23 09:12 UTC. Flag: requires KMS addendum. :package:

Luis (Partner Eng): Anna confirms: joint PR fine if we label "early access GA" and add a footnote about temporary reduced capacity. She will email legal with SKU placeholder "EC-EUW5-STD" — we need to confirm final marketplace SKU by EOD. :eyes:

Jia (Product): I'll draft copy and push to /marketing/partner-announces/edgecompute-euw5.md. Plan A: GA May 18 if quotas clear. Plan B: Early access May 18 with GA follow-up. Who owns customer comms if some customers are routed to eu-west3? :question:

Omar (Eng Runtime): Devex owns the routing messaging but Eng Runtime will provide the latency/breach numbers. I'll attach a minimal guidance snippet we can reuse in comms: 

```
Fallback routing guidance:
- Condition: capacity < requested for region
- Route policy: prefer eu-west5-local -> eu-west3-burst -> us-east1-fallback
- Max added latency budget: 120ms p95
- Customer opt-out flag: region_preference = "strict"
```

Sana (Partnerships): Nice. Mike — can you include the KMS addendum note in the ticket? EdgeCompute requires our marketplace entitlement to list support for customer-managed KMS. That's a gating legal item. :lock:

Mike (Cloud Ops): Added note and attached contract PDF to REG-5991. Also opened cloud vendor quota request (cloudvendor case #CV-21908). They asked for exact GPU SKU: "A100-80GB-eq" and quantity 12. I put quantity 12 but flagged as "8 guaranteed + 4 conditional on onboarding". :spiral_calendar:

Luis (Partner Eng): Confirmed Anna will send the 4-GPU commitment email to legal by EOD. She asked for the billing account ID to map marketplace SKU — sending now. :envelope_with_arrow:

Sana (Partnerships): If vendor quota comes back slow, alternate plan: do a limited partner-only early access with 8 GPUs and throttle by token quota. Jia, include an "invite-only" option in the draft. :bulb:

Jia (Product): Will do. Also adding a short FAQ line: "Why some customers see eu-west3?" — answer: temporary burst routing to preserve latency SLAs. Draft in 30m. :writing_hand:

Omar (Eng Runtime): One more technical ask — we need confirmation of kernel/driver versions on partner hosts to match our quantified benchmark. Luis, can you get the host spec sheet (NIC, driver, CUDA, MIG config) from EdgeCompute? We need it for the runtime perf cert. :computer:

Luis (Partner Eng): On it. Anna said she'll push the spec sheet to the shared S3 bucket: s3://partner-sharing/edgecompute/eu-west5/specs.json — I'll paste the link when available. :truck:

Sana (Partnerships): Great. Final check: press timing — Jia, we only issue the PR if Mike sees quota + KMS addendum in REG-5991 and Luis confirms the extra 4 GPUs email. Otherwise we put it in "early access" mode. Everyone OK with that? :wave:

Mike (Cloud Ops): Yep. Will update REG-5991 with status changes. Will ping here when cloud vendor confirms CV-21908. :thumbsup:

EdgeComputeBot: Reminder: Marketplace entitlement review window scheduled for 2026-03-24 16:00 UTC. Reviewer: MarketplaceOps. :calendar:

Luis (Partner Eng): Adding: Anna just uploaded spec sheet link -> https://storage.edgecompute.co/partners/eu-west5/specs.json — NIC: Mellanox ConnectX-6, CUDA 12.1, driver 525.60.11. Passing to Omar. :link:

Omar (Eng Runtime): Received spec sheet. Quick scan: CUDA 12.1 OK, need to validate driver minor versions in our perf harness. If all good we'll sign off on runtime cert by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:

Sana (Partnerships): Awesome. I'll close out with partners after we get the CV and REG tickets green. Thanks all! :pray:
